_comment: Arcade idle/attract playlist: cyd_push.py --idle --profile arcade (or "profile": "arcade" in config.json). Same format as _idle.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored. ASCII text only. Durations are seconds. The cabinet name can also be set in config.json ("cabinet") without editing this file.
